mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (name, repository_url, status, analyzed_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{repositoryUrl}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, repository_url AS "repositoryUrl", status, created_at AS "createdAt", analyzed_at AS "analyzedAt" FROM projects WHERE id = #{projectId}

SELECT sc.id AS "classId", sc.class_name AS "className", sm.id AS "methodId", sm.http_method AS "httpMethod", sm.request_path AS "requestPath", sm.method_name AS "methodName" FROM source_classes sc JOIN source_methods sm ON sm.class_id = sc.id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND sc.component_type = 'CONTROLLER' AND sm.http_method IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sc.class_name, sm.request_path, sm.method_name

SELECT sc.id AS "classId", sc.class_name AS "className", sc.component_type AS "componentType", sm.id AS "methodId", sm.method_name AS "methodName", sm.signature AS "signature", sm.return_type AS "returnType", sm.start_line AS "startLine", sm.end_line AS "endLine" FROM source_classes sc JOIN source_methods sm ON sm.class_id = sc.id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY sc.class_name, sm.start_line
